root_cause: The dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler unconditionally prevents default and stops propagation for Escape key, preventing the modal from receiving the Escape event when the dropdown is not open.
repair_strategy: Modify dataApiKeydownHandler to allow Escape to bubble up when the dropdown is not showing (i.e., button lacks the SHOW class), while preserving existing behavior to close the dropdown when it is open.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape while focus is on the access button will now hide the share dialog, making the button invisible, allowing keyboard users to dismiss the dialog.
functional_risks: Altered Escape handling may affect edge cases where dropdown state is ambiguous; however, the change only affects Escape when dropdown is not open, preserving existing behavior when dropdown is open.
Ensure that other keyboard interactions (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Space) remain unaffected.
verification_requirements: Verify that Escape closes the share dialog when the dropdown menu is not open.
Verify that Escape closes only the dropdown menu when it is open, without closing the modal.
Verify that ArrowUp, ArrowDown, and Space keys still operate correctly in both open and closed dropdown states.
